name: Linda Tuhiwai Smith
shortBio: Māori (Ngāti Awa, Ngāti Porou) philosopher of science and education whose Decolonizing Methodologies transformed global Indigenous epistemology and research ethics.
centralQuestion: How has Western "research" functioned as an instrument of imperial extraction, and how does Kaupapa Māori methodology reclaim epistemic sovereignty?

keyWorks.title: Decolonizing Methodologies: Research and Indigenous Peoples
keyWorks.description: Landmark critique of colonial knowledge production establishing 25 Indigenous research projects rooted in self-determination.
